## Hotels and prices for 2027

Price per person in USD for a 4-day / 3-night programme. All options include three nights in Rio de Janeiro, breakfast and the services specified in the itinerary. Hotels may be replaced by similar properties in the same category.

| 5★ | Miramar by Windsor, Standard Room + BB + Services | $3,219 | $1,912 | $1,755 |

## A short introduction to Rio

Two guided excursions, each lasting four hours, leave time to relax and explore independently. The Sugar Loaf cable car offers views of Copacabana and Guanabara Bay. On the next day, the route through Tijuca Forest leads to Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer.

This programme can be booked as a standalone short break or added to a longer South American itinerary. The Rio by Night show with dinner and the Rocinha community tour are optional experiences at an additional cost.
